title: V3.4 Detection Ground Truth Schema
description: Schema for independent human ground-truth 2D bounding boxes and footpoints in industrial camera streams.

facility_id.description: Unique identifier of the physical facility (e.g. WH_EUROPE_01).

camera_id.description: Unique identifier of the surveying camera stream (e.g. Camera_0001).

frame_id.description: Zero-indexed frame sequential number within the camera stream.

timestamp.description: Stream timestamp in seconds relative to synchronization zero.

object_id.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier of the annotated entity.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates formatted as [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in pixels.

foot_point.description: Ground contact point formatted as [u, v] in pixel coordinates.

visibility.description: Proportion of entity visible [0.0, 1.0], or UNKNOWN if obscured/indeterminate.
